title: 新語5語 + 復習クイズ5問
status_note: 8/12〜8/25のレッスンが作成されていなかったため、8/11学習語のDay2〜14(本来8/12〜8/24)、8/3学習語のDay14(本来8/16)、7/25学習語のDay30(本来8/23)がすべて未消化でした。本日まとめてSRS復習します(8/11語は実質Day16相当)。

new_words.meaning_en: a standard or point of reference against which things may be compared or assessed; to measure something against such a standard
new_words.meaning_ja: 基準点・参照値、ベンチマーク / (動)基準と比較・評価する
examples: The new factory's output became the benchmark for all other plants in the group.
We benchmarked our defect rate against industry leaders to find out how much improvement the DX investment could realistically deliver.(不良率を業界トップ企業と比較し、DX投資で現実的に狙える改善幅を把握した)

new_words.meaning_en: the process of repeating a procedure with the aim of approaching a desired result; a single cycle of that process
new_words.meaning_ja: 反復・繰り返し、1サイクル / AIや製品開発における「イテレーション」
examples: Each iteration of the design brought the product closer to what customers needed.
The data-science team ran three iterations of model training before the defect-prediction accuracy met the threshold.(予測精度が基準を満たすまで、データサイエンスチームはモデル学習を3回反復した)

new_words.meaning_en: the fact or condition of being responsible to others for one's decisions and actions; an obligation to explain and justify one's work
new_words.meaning_ja: 説明責任、アカウンタビリティ / 結果に対して責任を持ち、周囲に説明できる状態
examples: Clear roles and accountability are essential for any cross-functional project to succeed.
Building a culture of accountability in the team means each member owns their OKRs and reports progress transparently every sprint.(チームにアカウンタビリティ文化を根付かせるには、メンバー各自がOKRを自分事化し、スプリントごとに進捗を透明に報告する)

new_words.meaning_en: to adjust or fine-tune a process, model, or instrument so that it gives accurate results; to carefully assess a situation before acting
new_words.meaning_ja: (精度を)較正する・調整する / 状況に合わせて微調整する
examples: Before shipping, engineers must calibrate all sensors on the production line.
We need to calibrate our AI model's confidence thresholds after each batch of new training data to keep false-positive alerts low.(新たな訓練データを追加するたびにAIモデルの信頼度閾値を再調整し、誤報アラートを抑える必要がある)

new_words.meaning_en: the quality of being open, honest, and not secretive, especially in the way that information is communicated
new_words.meaning_ja: 透明性・オープンであること / 情報や意思決定プロセスを隠さない姿勢
examples: Transparency in leadership helps build trust across the entire organization.
In my coaching sessions, I emphasize transparency: sharing both successes and failures with the team drives faster learning.(コーチングでは透明性を重視し、成功も失敗もチームと共有することで学習を加速させる)

review_quiz.q: 空欄補充: "We need to ________ our AI model's thresholds every time new training data arrives."(新しい訓練データが届くたびにAIモデルの閾値を'再調整する')
review_quiz.answer: calibrate — "We need to calibrate our AI model's thresholds every time new training data arrives."

review_quiz.q: 次の説明に最も近い語は?「資源・予算・人員を特定の目的のために正式に'割り当てる'動詞」 (a) adopt (b) allocate (c) abandon (d) assess
review_quiz.answer: (b) allocate — 例: "Allocate two engineers to the DX pilot before the Q3 deadline."

review_quiz.q: 空欄補充: "Our new cloud platform is ________ enough to expand from one plant to all twelve within a year."(1工場から12工場へ1年で広げられるほど'拡張可能な')
review_quiz.answer: scalable — "Our new cloud platform is scalable enough to expand from one plant to all twelve within a year."

review_quiz.q: 「既存のデータや資源を'活用する'」動詞。名詞では'てこ・影響力'の意味も持つ語は? ヒント: l_____e
review_quiz.answer: leverage — 例: "We can leverage the sensor data we already collect to reduce unplanned downtime."

review_quiz.q: 空欄補充: "We invited all ________s to the kickoff meeting so no one's requirements would be missed."(誰の要件も漏れないよう、すべての'利害関係者'をキックオフに招いた)
review_quiz.answer: stakeholders — "We invited all stakeholders to the kickoff meeting so no one's requirements would be missed."

practice: 今日の新語(benchmark / iteration / accountability / calibrate / transparency)と既習語を2語以上組み合わせ、あなたのDX推進やチームマネジメントの場面を英語1〜2文で書いてみましょう。例: "After each iteration of the model, we calibrate the thresholds and share results openly to build transparency with stakeholders."
